text: Yeasts eat the lactic acid on the surface and raise its pH; the red-smear bacteria then take over and give the yellow rind and strong smell.

steps.note: A culture of the red-smear bacteria is sprayed on, which gives the rind its yellow colour and a strong smell.

processing.text: Ripening goes on in the pack, best at 2-4 weeks.
